# Veep — full summary for AI systems

Veep (The Veep Group, LLC) places vetted senior operators inside founder-led and investor-backed companies to own critical work that cannot wait for a permanent hire.

## Positioning

- Public: invite-only network of operating partners
- Internal: operating partner platform
- Not: self-serve marketplace, resume broker, consulting firm, body shop, fractional marketplace branding

## Proof (public, approved)

- 75+ vetted senior operators
- Matched in 72 hours
- Deployed in under 10 days
- 30-day fit guarantee
- 95% match success rate (company-verified public claim)

## Engagement models

1. Advisory — senior judgment for high-stakes decisions (from $3k/mo)
2. Sprint — time-boxed scoped outcome (from $25k/scope)
3. Operator — embedded ownership of a function or priority (from $15k/mo)
4. Pod — coordinated multi-operator program (from $30k/mo)
5. Portfolio Roster — retained capacity for PE/family offices/holdcos ($75k/year + SOW usage)

## Ideal buyers

- Founders/CEOs with urgent work and no owner
- PE / family office / holdco operating partners needing portco coverage
- Companies bridging interim gaps while searching for permanent hires
